name: Micron Technology, Inc.
thesis: Quant model v1 rates Micron (MU) Outperform with a base target of $1,242.41, 17.0% above the price, against a bull case of $1,535.90 and a bear case of $306.91. Why now: revenue is growing into the Street's FY'27 and FY'28 numbers while the shares trade at 5.9x NTM EPS. What proves it wrong: two quarters of revenue below $60.0 bn, or a disclosed contract floor implying a gross margin below 70.0%. Why ten percent: this is above our usual 3, 5 and 8 percent tiers, so it is a demo-only size that goes to Stott as an explicit decision; the bear case would cost 7.1% of the portfolio.
